purpose: Choose a typed identity/scope model for controlled definition lookup and finite recursion before any accepted MTS v0.3 semantics.
nonNormativeUntil: A separate versioned semantic contract and cross-language conformance corpus are accepted and linked from mts-contract.

identityModels.name: canonical-display-string-as-definition-identity
identityModels.reason: Formatting is presentation. Equal-looking occurrences must not become one semantic introduction merely because they print the same way.

identityModels.name: source-span-as-definition-identity
identityModels.reason: SourceSpan is provenance/debug data and changes under harmless source edits.

identityModels.name: target-structural-key-as-definition-identity
identityModels.reason: A source-span-independent structural target key is useful for deterministic lookup but it identifies the requested target shape, not the introduction event. Child scopes may intentionally introduce the same target key with a distinct identity.

identityModels.name: resolved-L1-link-as-definition-identity
identityModels.reason: Definition lookup must remain possible without L4 reads or materialization and before the target has an L1 realization.

identityModels.name: scoped-introduction-id-plus-structural-lookup-key
identityModels.reason: Separates introduction identity from target matching, permits finite recursive state keyed by introduction identity, and keeps provenance non-semantic.

definitionId.meaning: deterministic replay-local identity of one registered introduction

targetKey.note: The current Python structural_key helper is a suitable challenge instrument only because it is explicitly not semantic equality.

scopeModel.reason: ContextFrame is a binary interpretation-role environment, not a symbol table. Definition scope must be explicit so context pronouns never become global variables by accident.

contextModel.note: This decision only chooses lookup separation. How a resolved body is interpreted against the caller/introduced context remains a challenge gate.

finiteRecursionModel.repeatActiveDefinition: emit explicit cycle reference to the active DefinitionId
finiteRecursionModel.termination: finite for a finite registered DefinitionEnvironment graph
finiteRecursionModel.importantBoundary: Dependency/form matching that creates graph edges is not accepted by this decision; only the identity of graph states is chosen.
